card.name: Space before numbers; "non" before hyphen
card.fires_on: The space just before a number in casualty counts ("more than", "killing"), and the word "non" in "non-vented" or "non-USB". It also fires on a few other words that start a modifier before a noun, such as "External" and "new".

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: A bare space token just before a number of people, after phrases like "more than" or "killing".
modes.example: of the more than<< >>900 men aboard, only some

modes.label: "non" in compounds
modes.description: The word "non" before a hyphenated term such as non-vented or non-USB.
modes.example: To prevent air embolism, use a<< non>>-vented infusion set or close the vent

modes.label: Equipment modifiers
modes.description: A modifier word beginning a description of a device or its power source.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a number or a hyphenated "non-" term is about to come next.
